51:
DictionaryGenerator - Dictionary Generator for Table Driven Text Input Processor from CHT/CHS Table Driven IMM32 IME.
 
RunDll32.exe TableTextService.dll DictionaryGenerator [parameters] <output text file name>
 Parameter can be specified for
 -format:<name>
 Specifies input text file format.
 <name> Traditional | Simplified | HongKong
 -section:<name>:<input text file name>
 Specifies input text file name with section.
 <name> SettingFile | KeyStroke | Radical | Text | Phrase | Symbol
 <input text file name> Specifies input text file name.
 -cp:<code page>
 Specifies code page value for convert Unicode from ASCII input text file.
 -help or -? : Show help
 <output file name>
 Specifies text file name of output dictionary file.
